opening.argument: The video delivers practical instructions for closing an RBC Royal Bank account through four ordinary channels: by telephone, by mailing a letter, at a branch, or through an electronic request in online banking. The speaker expressly identifies these methods, including “four ways that you can close your account with RBC” and the option of “stopping by an RBC Royal Bank branch and doing it in person.” The separate Cash App referral appears as a distinct offer rather than part of the account-closure guidance. The available evidence does not describe deception, unavailable rewards, or a completed transaction, so the material is best understood as educational and operational banking guidance.
